items.title: Add continuous repository validation workflow
acceptance_criteria: A GitHub Actions workflow runs the repository validator on pull requests and pushes to main.
The workflow uses a supported Python version and does not require secrets.
Workflow syntax and local validation are checked before completion.
evidence: .github/workflows/validate.yml
GitHub Actions run 44440385449 — validate job succeeded on commit 3fff789f834ffa06b3b5ce90ddfa092a28e8353f

items.title: Define contribution and pull request templates
acceptance_criteria: Contribution guidance explains setup, checks, branch and commit expectations.
Pull request template requires scope, verification evidence, risks, and linked work item.
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md
/.github/pull_request_template.md

items.title: Define security, privacy, and audio data lifecycle baseline
acceptance_criteria: Threat boundaries, sensitive data classes, and trust assumptions are documented.
Retention, deletion propagation, access control, and audit requirements are specified.
Audio/transcript prompt-injection and tenant-isolation risks are addressed.
evidence: docs/operations/security-and-data-lifecycle.md

items.title: Compare durable workflow and agent orchestration options
acceptance_criteria: At least three viable approaches are compared using current official documentation.
Comparison covers durability, retries, human/agent task handoff, language support, operations, and licensing.
Recommendation and unresolved assumptions are recorded in an ADR or research note.
evidence: docs/research/durable-orchestration-options.md (Temporal, DBOS, Restate; official docs, agent handoff patterns, and upstream licenses checked 2026-11-19)

items.title: Define versioning, compatibility, and release policy
acceptance_criteria: Public API and event compatibility expectations are documented.
Versioning, deprecation, release, and rollback rules are documented.
evidence: docs/operations/versioning-and-release-policy.md

items.title: Create reproducible local development environment
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout has documented commands for setup and validation.
Local checks do not require paid services or production credentials.
evidence: .python-version
Makefile (bootstrap/check/validate/test targets)
tests/test_validate_repo.py (7 black-box tests)
GitHub Actions run 44440466616 — make check passed; validator passed and all 7 unit tests passed on Python 3.12.16

items.title: Complete detailed threat model and security controls matrix
acceptance_criteria: Assets, actors, trust boundaries, entry points, and abuse cases are enumerated.
Threats include tenant escape, malicious audio/transcript instructions, parser exploitation, provider leakage, credential compromise, replay/duplicate side effects, and deletion failures.
Each material threat has a mitigation, verification method, and residual-risk note.
The threat model is linked to tests and operational controls.
evidence: docs/security/threat-model.md — 16 threats, trust boundaries, security invariants, mitigations, verification methods, residual risks, and reassessment triggers

items.title: Define canonical audio asset and ingestion session contracts
acceptance_criteria: Versioned schemas define audio assets, ingestion sessions, source metadata, media properties, and lifecycle states.
Contracts support batch ingestion and leave room for streaming without requiring a streaming implementation.
Validation rules cover media type, duration, size, channels, sample rate, and integrity metadata.
Contract fixtures and compatibility tests are included.
evidence: contracts/schemas/audio-asset.v1.schema.json
contracts/schemas/ingestion-session.v1.schema.json
contracts/examples/*.valid.json and contracts/README.md
tests/test_contract_schemas.py — batch/stream, format, tenant, checksum, lifecycle, and schema identity tests
GitHub Actions run 44440826071 — make check passed; 17/17 tests passed on Python 3.12

items.title: Evaluate media probing and normalization tools
acceptance_criteria: At least three viable approaches are compared using current official documentation.
Comparison covers supported containers/codecs, metadata accuracy, malformed-input exposure, sandboxability, deployment footprint, performance, and license implications.
Recommendation distinguishes metadata inspection from transcoding/normalization.
A reproducible proof-of-concept plan and known limitations are documented.
evidence: docs/research/media-probing-options.md — FFmpeg/ffprobe, GStreamer, MediaInfo, and Mutagen compared; licensing, isolation, deployment, metadata-vs-transcoding, and PoC gates documented; official sources checked 2026-11-19

items.title: Implement isolated media inspection and validation adapter
acceptance_criteria: The adapter derives authoritative media metadata from file bytes rather than client hints.
Metadata validation covers container, duration, byte size, sample rate, channels, and audio-track presence.
A separate full-file decode gate detects malformed and truncated audio; metadata probing alone is never treated as full decode validation.
Failures use stable error codes and bounded probe/decode time, input size, probe parameters, and output.
Fixtures and tests cover valid media, malformed metadata, unsupported containers, truncated media, and limit-exceeding inputs.
evidence: src/voxpipe/media/probe.py — FFprobeMediaInspector with a:0/V:0 selectors, local-only protocol, timeouts, probe/analyze limits, output cap, stable errors
src/voxpipe/media/validation.py — FFmpegDecodeValidator for full-file audio decode with -xerror and err_detect=explode
tests/test_media_probe.py and tests/test_media_validation.py — mocked failures and real synthetic WAV, malformed bytes, and truncated WAV integration tests
GitHub Actions run 44441640109 — FFmpeg/ffprobe 8.0.1, repository validation passed, 39/39 tests passed

items.title: Define object storage port and implement local filesystem adapter
acceptance_criteria: A provider-neutral object storage port defines put, get/open, head, and delete operations without exposing provider SDK types.
The local adapter writes atomically, prevents path traversal, verifies content length/checksum, and supports idempotent object keys.
Tests cover overwrite/conflict policy, missing objects, corrupted checksums, path traversal, interrupted writes, and deletion.
Storage references remain opaque and compatible with AudioAsset v1.
evidence: src/voxpipe/storage/ports.py — provider-neutral ObjectStoragePort
src/voxpipe/storage/local.py — atomic local filesystem adapter with SHA-256, size limits, idempotency, conflict and path/symlink protection
tests/test_local_storage.py — 12 storage tests covering round-trip, atomicity, interrupted writes, checksum, traversal, symlink escape, and conflicts
docs/architecture/storage.md — boundary and deployment limitations
GitHub Actions run 44442217659 — 51/51 tests passed

items.title: Implement batch ingestion application service
acceptance_criteria: The service accepts a staged local media file and authenticated tenant context, not a client-controlled filesystem path.
It creates an idempotent session, probes metadata, performs full decode validation, computes SHA-256, and stores the immutable asset.
Session and asset lifecycle transitions are explicit and invalid transitions fail closed.
Failures trigger bounded cleanup/compensation and never leave a completed session without an accepted asset.
Unit and integration tests cover duplicate requests, storage failures, parser failures, and tenant mismatch.
evidence: src/voxpipe/ingestion/service.py — batch orchestration, staging-root enforcement, SHA-256 request fingerprint, state transitions, idempotency, tenant scoping, asset creation, and compensation
src/voxpipe/ingestion/repository.py — SQLite WAL repository with FULL synchronous commits, unique tenant/idempotency constraint, tenant-scoped lookups, and compare-and-swap state updates
contracts/schemas/ingestion-session.v1.schema.json — retention policy and allowlisted declared_by source metadata
tests/test_ingestion_service.py — schema validation, idempotent replay/conflict, tenant isolation, path protection, probe/decode/storage failures, staged mutation, cleanup, and repository reopen
docs/architecture/ingestion.md — processing flow, persistence boundary, failure semantics, and known recovery limitations
GitHub Actions run 44442849625 — repository validation passed (14 work items); 67/67 tests passed, including real FFmpeg/ffprobe integration tests

items.title: Add stale ingestion recovery, leases, and orphan reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Workers claim active sessions with unique expiring lease owners; concurrent claims fail closed and state updates use compare-and-swap.
Sessions persist only a relative private staging reference; expired leases can resume the same asset ID/object key without duplicate assets.
Recovery handles restart points before storage, after object write, and after asset metadata commit.
A failed-session reconciler retries cleanup of associated object bytes and asset metadata and returns a structured audit report.
Fault-injection tests cover live lease contention, expired lease recovery, missing staged files, session expiry, and orphan cleanup.
evidence: src/voxpipe/ingestion/repository.py — atomic expiring lease claims, per-attempt ownership, recoverable-session scans, and state-scoped reconciliation queries

src/voxpipe/ingestion/service.py — relative private staging references, lease refresh at transitions, resumable processing with stable asset IDs/timestamps, expiry handling, and idempotent storage/metadata replay
src/voxpipe/ingestion/recovery.py — recovery worker and structured failed/expired-session orphan reconciliation report
contracts/schemas/ingestion-session.v1.schema.json — validated staging_reference and lease contracts
tests/test_ingestion_recovery.py — exclusive claim, lease expiry, live lease, recovery at finalizing/processing/object/asset boundaries, missing staging, expiry, and orphan cleanup
GitHub Actions run 44443854990 — repository validation passed (14 work items); 75/75 tests passed

items.title: Implement PostgreSQL ingestion repository and schema migrations
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL schema preserves tenant-scoped idempotency and compare-and-swap session transitions.
Migrations are versioned and tested from an empty database and previous schema version.
Concurrent duplicate submissions produce one session and one asset.
Tenant isolation and transaction rollback behavior have integration tests.
evidence: src/voxpipe/ingestion/postgres.py — PostgreSQL repository with transaction-local tenant context, forced-RLS-compatible queries, idempotency, CAS, row-locked lease claims, and tenant-scoped scans
migrations/postgres/0001_create_ingestion_tables.sql — initial session/asset tables and tenant-scoped uniqueness
migrations/postgres/0002_add_tenant_rls_and_updated_at.sql — update timestamps, indexes, enabled/forced RLS policies
tests/test_postgres_repository.py — v1-to-v2 upgrade, migration idempotency, forced RLS, tenant isolation, concurrent session/asset writes, lease contention, CAS rollback, and scoped recovery scans
requirements-postgres.txt — optional runtime driver; CI provisions PostgreSQL 16 and a separate non-superuser NOBYPASSRLS application role
docs/architecture/postgres.md — migration, deployment role model, and RLS trust boundary
GitHub Actions run 44444772532 — repository validation passed (16 work items); 84/84 tests passed including PostgreSQL 16 integration tests

items.title: Expose authenticated batch upload API and durable ingestion job queue
acceptance_criteria: Upload initiation, streamed byte transfer, finalization, status, and cancellation have versioned API contracts.
Tenant identity is derived only from authenticated context; arbitrary client filesystem paths and storage keys are never accepted.
A PostgreSQL-backed queue uses atomic claims, expiring leases, bounded retries, and a dead-letter state.
API requests return durable session/job identifiers and do not hold HTTP connections open for media processing.
Integration tests cover duplicate upload requests, interrupted transfers, worker restart, cancellation races, tenant isolation, and retry exhaustion.
evidence: migrations/postgres/0003_create_durable_ingestion_jobs.sql — tenant-scoped queue schema, session foreign key, lease invariants, claim index, and forced RLS
src/voxpipe/ingestion/jobs.py — idempotent enqueue, atomic SKIP LOCKED claims, expiring leases, heartbeat, stale-owner fencing, bounded retry/dead-letter, and atomic session/job cancellation

tests/test_postgres_repository.py — queue idempotency, tenant isolation, concurrent claims, lease expiry/reclaim, stale-owner rejection, retry exhaustion, cancellation, and RLS tests (CI verification pending)

items.title: Expose ingestion and search capabilities through MCP and agent skill contracts
acceptance_criteria: MCP tools expose upload initiation, ingestion status, asset lookup, and search without bypassing authorization.
Agent skill manifests define inputs, outputs, error codes, retry semantics, and least-privilege scopes.
Contract tests exercise an external agent client against the MCP surface.
The same capability contracts can generate CLI/SDK documentation without duplicating business logic.
